style: 3D animated cartoon, feature-film quality animation, smooth natural motion, expressive acting, consistent characters, stable camera, soft cinematic lighting

shots.prompt: Four cartoon siblings leap through the air in a chaotic tangle reaching for a flying orange tablet, the girl stretches her arms, the boys grab and kick, pillows, chips and toy bricks fly around them, dynamic action, camera slowly pushes in

A calm toddler in a white cap types super fast on an orange tablet with tiny fingers, glowing blue holographic code swirls and rotates around him, red alert light pulses in the room, he blinks and glances up calmly
A bossy girl with a ponytail talks angrily toward the camera, mouth moving as she speaks, she shakes her pointing finger, raises her eyebrows, ponytail sways, she taps the planner in her other hand
A girl with a ponytail lowers her pointing hand, rolls her eyes, sighs and talks with an annoyed expression, mouth moving, then points again firmly
A lazy boy in a yellow cap sinks into the beanbag, slowly takes a chip from the bag and munches it, chewing with half-closed eyes, then talks lazily with his mouth moving, crumbs fall on his shirt
A lazy boy in a yellow cap on a beanbag lifts one hand and waves it lazily while explaining something, mouth moving as he talks, raises an eyebrow, then lets his arm drop back down
An excited boy in an orange number 10 football kit jumps and celebrates a goal, pumping both fists in the air and shouting, the soft ball bounces off the sofa, cushions fly, energetic motion
A calm toddler in a white cap sits cross-legged and swipes on the glowing orange tablet, he speaks calmly without looking up, mouth moving slightly, app icons float and twinkle around the screen

In the living room the girl with the ponytail steps forward and puts her hands on her hips, talking like a commander, the lazy boy on the yellow beanbag keeps munching chips, the toddler on the sofa keeps staring at his tablet, slow camera push-in

A sassy boy in an orange kit with arms crossed taps his foot on the football and talks confidently with head tilts and a smirk, mouth moving, his lazy brother on the beanbag slowly chews chips and rolls his eyes
A girl with a ponytail counts on her fingers while talking, then suddenly freezes, looks up confused, taps her chin and squints, trying to remember

Red alert lights flash and pulse in the living room, a big red warning blinks on the TV, the girl grabs her head in shock, the boy on the beanbag jolts and drops his chips, the toddler keeps typing calmly
A girl screams in panic, eyes huge, shaking her head while holding it with both hands, hair flying, red light flashing on her face
A tired boy in a yellow cap on a beanbag slowly drags his hand down his face with a huge sigh, his shoulders drop, then he talks with a dry bored expression, red light glowing
An excited boy in an orange kit bounces up and down on the spot, tapping his fingers in the air super fast, huge grin, talking excitedly
A sneaker foot stomps down into a colorful toy brick city, the towers explode and hundreds of plastic bricks fly in every direction in slow motion, bricks bounce on the rug
A girl kneeling on the rug apologizes, pressing her hands together, sad guilty eyes blinking, she talks softly with her mouth moving and lowers her head
A sad boy kneeling among broken toy bricks, his lower lip trembles, he wipes a tear with his arm, then lifts his chin bravely and talks with determination
Siblings rebuild a toy brick tower together, the toddler hands a long brick to the boy, the boy smiles and clicks it onto the tower, the girl stacks more bricks, the tower grows, warm teamwork
A lazy boy on a beanbag yawns hugely, then lazily taps the laptop with one finger, a green check mark glows on the screen, he talks sleepily and reaches into the chip bag

Four siblings celebrate around a tall finished toy brick tower, the boy in orange jumps and cheers, the girl nods proudly with hands on hips, the toddler smiles holding his tablet, the boy in the yellow cap munches a chip
Four siblings sit on the sofa smiling far too innocently at the camera, swinging their legs, blinking, the girl waves and talks cheerfully to the camera, the toddler hides the tablet behind his back
A toddler in a white cap leans toward the camera, looks straight at it with a deadpan face, slowly raises one eyebrow and says one short word, tablet glowing
